The central figure is a large, muscular character in a blue and black suit with yellow accents, wearing sunglasses. Below are two smaller characters, one in red and one in orange/yellow, appearing to be in action poses. The background is a solid light green. There are speech bubbles in the top left corner containing text, and a title or caption at the bottom. A small circular logo is visible in the top right.
